title: The Unwritten Regiment
author: August Quintana
blurb: Xanthe Montrose, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
